findings.summary: Deftform v1.0 became publicly available on April 2, 2024 after about one month of private beta.
Ease of use, quick setup, clean design, and straightforward embedding are the strongest repeated themes.
Users repeatedly value unlimited responses and the lifetime or prepaid pricing model over recurring subscriptions.
The product now covers core forms plus conditional logic, payments, integrations, file uploads, teams, and API access.
Some users report bugs or reliability problems, including SSL or asset-delivery failures.
Advanced layout, customization, workflow, and data-handling controls remain common requests on the public feedback board.
The 4.8 AppSumo rating is strong, but Capterra has zero reviews and Trustpilot only one, so platform diversity is much thinner than the headline sample suggests.
Current support response quality and production reliability require hands-on testing because recent reports conflict.

config.research_note: Broad AppSumo sample plus smaller Product Hunt, Trustpilot, Reddit, and hands-on editorial signals. Capterra has a listing but zero user reviews.
